data.report: November 24, 2026 | 3:51 PM If you were out today, you know the skiing and riding was great. Chalky snow could be found in spots, with groomers offering top-to-bottom turns across the mountain. With the current snowpack looking promising, Mountain Operations is anticipating additional terrain expansion as conditions allow. For more details on what could be opening next, check out our latest Operations Blog .
